title: G7 Nations Agree to Release Emergency Fuel Reserves to Lower Diesel Prices
subtitle: Global leaders act to prevent export bans and stabilize fuel costs after intense pressure from the United States.

summary.en: Leaders from the G7 nations have agreed to release 100 million barrels of emergency oil and diesel. This decision follows a threat from the United States to stop all diesel exports to protect its own supply. The move aims to lower record-high fuel prices that are hurting economies worldwide. European countries, which rely on imports to meet their energy needs, will now avoid a potential fuel shortage. Officials hope this coordinated action will stabilize the market before the situation worsens.
summary.zh: 七大工業國集團領袖已達成協議，將釋出一億桶緊急原油與柴油儲備。此決定源於美國為保護國內供應而威脅停止所有柴油出口。此舉旨在降低正衝擊全球經濟的歷史性高燃料價格。仰賴進口以滿足能源需求的歐洲國家，因此得以避免潛在的燃料短缺。官員們希望這項協調行動能在情勢惡化前穩定市場。

paragraphs.en: In a major effort to lower rising energy costs, leaders of the G7 nations have agreed to release up to 100 million barrels of their emergency diesel and crude oil stockpiles. This decision comes after a period of intense pressure from the United States, where record-high fuel prices have become a significant concern before the upcoming November elections. According to The Guardian, the agreement involves releasing 50 million barrels of diesel and 50 million barrels of crude oil into the global market to help cool down prices.
paragraphs.zh: 為了降低不斷攀升的能源成本，七大工業國集團（G7）領袖已達成協議，將釋出最多一億桶的緊急柴油與原油儲備。這項決定是在美國面臨巨大壓力後所做出的，因為美國即將在十一月舉行大選，而創下歷史新高的燃料價格已成為選民極度關切的議題。根據《衛報》（The Guardian）報導，這項協議內容包括向全球市場釋出五千萬桶柴油與五千萬桶原油，以協助平抑價格。

paragraphs.en: This announcement follows urgent discussions held on Friday, led by French President Emmanuel Macron. The talks were organized to address the global surge in diesel prices and a specific threat from US President Donald Trump. Mr. Trump had warned that he was considering a ban on US diesel exports unless European countries agreed to use their own emergency supplies. An export ban—a government order that stops goods from being sent to other countries—would have created a dangerous situation for Europe, which relies on these imports to meet its energy needs.
paragraphs.zh: 這項宣布是在法國總統馬克宏（Emmanuel Macron）主持的緊急會議後發布的。會議旨在解決全球柴油價格飆漲的問題，以及美國總統川普（Donald Trump）所提出的特定威脅。川普曾警告，除非歐洲國家同意使用各自的緊急儲備，否則他考慮禁止美國出口柴油。出口禁令（即政府下令禁止將商品運往其他國家）將使歐洲陷入危險境地，因為歐洲必須仰賴這些進口燃料來滿足能源需求。

paragraphs.en: Europe currently produces about 70% of the diesel it uses from its own refineries. However, it still depends on imports to cover the remaining gap. The global supply of fuel has been limited by several factors, including ongoing disruptions to exports from the Middle East and attacks on Russian refineries, which have caused Russia's fuel output to reach its lowest level in 20 years. As a result, the US had been exporting record amounts of diesel to overseas buyers, which caused its own fuel supplies to drop to their lowest levels since 1996.
paragraphs.zh: 歐洲目前約有七成的柴油需求由境內煉油廠供應，但仍需仰賴進口來填補剩餘缺口。全球燃料供應受到多項因素限制，包括中東地區出口持續受阻，以及俄羅斯煉油廠遭受攻擊，導致俄國燃料產量降至二十年來的最低水準。因此，美國先前向海外買家出口了創紀錄數量的柴油，導致其國內燃料庫存降至一九九六年以來的最低點。

paragraphs.en: In the United States, the high volume of exports pushed diesel prices to record highs, reaching over $5.85 a gallon in early September. This situation created a difficult choice for the US government, as it had to balance the needs of its own drivers with the stability of the global market. The threat of a US export ban had caused significant worry, as it would have forced countries in the UK and Europe to compete for the remaining available fuel, likely pushing prices even higher than current record levels.
paragraphs.zh: 在美國，龐大的出口量將柴油價格推升至歷史新高，九月初每加侖價格一度超過五點八五美元。這讓美國政府面臨兩難，必須在國內駕駛的需求與全球市場的穩定之間取得平衡。美國可能實施出口禁令的威脅引發了廣泛擔憂，因為這將迫使英國與歐洲國家爭奪剩餘的可用燃料，恐將導致價格進一步飆升，超越目前的紀錄。

paragraphs.en: In the UK, the impact on the economy is already clear. The average price of diesel at gas stations reached a record high of £2 a litre on Friday. According to the RAC motoring group, the cost of filling up an average family car is now £110, which is nearly £32 more than the cost before the war in Iran began. This rise in fuel costs puts heavy pressure on families, as well as on businesses that rely on lorries, vans, and farming vehicles to move goods and food.
paragraphs.zh: 在英國，對經濟的衝擊已顯而易見。週五，加油站的柴油平均價格達到每公升二英鎊的歷史新高。根據英國皇家汽車俱樂部（RAC）的數據，加滿一輛普通家庭用車的費用現已來到一百一十英鎊，比伊朗戰爭爆發前貴了近三十二英鎊。燃料成本上漲對家庭造成沉重壓力，也衝擊了仰賴貨車、廂型車與農用車輛來運送貨物與食品的企業。

paragraphs.en: President Macron stated that the G7 nations, which include the US, UK, Germany, Italy, Canada, and Japan, are committed to working together to bring down the prices of petroleum products. He explained that the countries will focus on releasing these reserves in a coordinated way, with a large portion of the diesel being released within the first 20 days. President Trump also confirmed the agreement on his Truth Social platform, noting that the process of releasing these massive amounts of diesel would begin immediately.
paragraphs.zh: 馬克宏總統表示，包含美國、英國、德國、義大利、加拿大與日本在內的七大工業國集團，承諾將共同努力降低石油產品價格。他解釋說，各國將採取協調一致的方式釋出儲備，其中大部分柴油將在二十天內釋出。川普總統也在其「真實社群」（Truth Social）平台上證實了這項協議，並指出釋出這些大量柴油的程序將立即啟動。

paragraphs.en: Looking ahead, the G7 ministers plan to meet again to discuss whether more fuel releases will be necessary. By choosing to release these strategic reserves—the emergency supply of fuel kept by a country for times of crisis—the G7 leaders hope to avoid the economic damage that a total export ban would have caused. While this move is intended to provide immediate relief, the global energy market remains fragile. The success of this plan will depend on how quickly the new supply reaches the market and whether it is enough to satisfy the high demand from drivers and businesses across the globe.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未來，七大工業國集團部長計畫再次會晤，討論是否有必要進一步釋出燃料。透過釋出這些戰略儲備（即國家為危機時期保留的緊急燃料供應），七大工業國集團領袖希望避免全面出口禁令可能造成的經濟損害。儘管此舉旨在提供即時緩解，但全球能源市場依然脆弱。這項計畫能否成功，將取決於新供應進入市場的速度，以及是否足以滿足全球駕駛與企業的高需求。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To make something less intense or to reduce the rapid growth of something.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 使冷卻、使降溫（指減緩價格飆漲）。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作物理意義的降溫，這裡指減緩市場價格。文中：According to The Guardian, the agreement involves releasing 50 million barrels of diesel and 50 million barrels of crude oil into the global market to help cool down prices.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To be enough money to pay for something or to deal with a need.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 足以支付、應付（需求或費用）。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「覆蓋」，這裡指滿足能源需求。文中：However, it still depends on imports to cover the remaining gap.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To put enough fuel into a vehicle to make the tank full.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「填滿」容器，這裡專指車輛加油。文中：According to the RAC motoring group, the cost of filling up an average family car is now £110, which is nearly £32 more than the cost before the war in Iran began.

quiz.question: What is the specific breakdown of the emergency fuel reserves that the G7 nations have agreed to release?

options.A: 100 million barrels of diesel and 50 million barrels of crude oil
options.B: 50 million barrels of diesel and 50 million barrels of crude oil
options.C: 70 million barrels of diesel and 30 million barrels of crude oil
options.D: 100 million barrels of crude oil only

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第一段最後一句明確指出，協議內容是釋放 5000 萬桶柴油與 5000 萬桶原油，總計 1 億桶。選項 A 將總數與柴油量混淆；選項 C 數字錯誤；選項 D 忽略了柴油的部分，與文中數據不符。

quiz.question: Based on the text, why was the United States government under significant pressure to act on diesel prices?

options.A: Because the US refineries were destroyed by recent attacks
options.B: Because the US government wanted to increase its own strategic reserves to record levels
options.C: Because high fuel prices were a major concern for voters ahead of the upcoming election
options.D: Because the UK had threatened to stop trading with the United States

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章第一段提到美國面臨壓力是因為「11 月大選前，創紀錄的高油價已成為重大隱憂」。選項 A 錯誤，文中提到被攻擊的是俄羅斯的煉油廠而非美國；選項 B 與文意相反，美國是因為出口過多導致庫存處於低點；選項 D 文中並未提及英國威脅美國，反而是美國威脅要禁止出口。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, the author writes that the global energy market remains 'fragile.' What does 'fragile' mean in this context?

options.A: Easily damaged or likely to become unstable
options.C: Completely controlled by a single government
options.D: Highly resistant to changes in supply and demand

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在此語境下，「fragile」意指市場狀況不穩定，容易受到外部因素影響而崩潰或出現問題。選項 B 是指成長迅速，與脆弱無關；選項 C 與文中提到的國際協調不符；選項 D 描述的是強健（robust）的市場，與脆弱的定義相反。

quiz.question: What is the central message of this article?

options.A: The G7 nations are planning to permanently stop using diesel fuel
options.B: The US government is solely responsible for the current global energy crisis
options.C: The G7 nations have coordinated a release of emergency fuel reserves to stabilize prices and avoid trade conflicts
options.D: The UK economy is the only one suffering from the recent rise in fuel costs

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章主旨圍繞在 G7 國家為了應對高油價與潛在的出口禁令威脅，協調釋放緊急儲備油。選項 A 文中並未提及要永久停止使用柴油；選項 B 過於偏頗，文中指出多種因素導致危機；選項 D 錯誤，文中提到美國與歐洲各國皆受到影響，不僅限於英國。
